def filter_api_calls(
    logp_with_result: np.ndarray,
    logp_call_only: np.ndarray,
    logp_no_call: np.ndarray,
    tau_filter: float,
) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
    """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
    # Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(logp_with_result, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_call_only, np.ndarray) or not isinstance(logp_no_call, np.ndarray):
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be numpy arrays.")
    if logp_with_result.ndim != 2 or logp_call_only.ndim != 2 or logp_no_call.ndim != 2:
        raise ValueError("Inputs must be 2-D matrices.")
    if logp_with_result.shape != logp_call_only.shape or logp_with_result.shape != logp_no_call.shape:
        raise ValueError("Input shapes must match.")
    if logp_with_result.size == 0:
        raise ValueError("Input matrices must not be empty.")
    if not np.isfinite(logp_with_result).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_call_only).all() or not np.isfinite(logp_no_call).all():
        raise ValueError("All entries must be finite.")
    if (logp_with_result > 0).any() or (logp_call_only > 0).any() or (logp_no_call > 0).any():
        raise ValueError("All entries must be nonpositive.")
    # Validate tau_filter
    if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
        raise ValueError("Boolean is not a valid threshold.")
    if not isinstance(tau_filter, (int, float, np.floating, np.integer)):
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a finite nonnegative number.")
    if not np.isfinite(tau_filter) or tau_filter < 0:
        raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite and nonnegative.")
    tau_filter = float(tau_filter)

    n_candidates, future_horizon = logp_with_result.shape
    # Compute normalized weights per T01
    t = np.arange(future_horizon)
    raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
    weight_sum = raw_weights.sum()
    if weight_sum == 0:
        weights = np.ones(future_horizon) / future_horizon
    else:
        weights = raw_weights / weight_sum

    loss_with = -logp_with_result
    loss_call = -logp_call_only
    loss_no   = -logp_no_call

    L_with = np.dot(loss_with, weights)
    L_call = np.dot(loss_call, weights)
    L_no   = np.dot(loss_no, weights)

    delta_with_call = L_no - L_with
    delta_call_with = L_call - L_with
    margin = delta_with_call - tau_filter * delta_call_with
    keep = margin > 0

    return keep, margin
